items.titleZh: Vera Rubin 凭借领先性能首次亮相，NVIDIA 横扫 MLPerf 训练和端点
items.titleEn: NVIDIA Sweeps MLPerf Training and Endpoints as Vera Rubin Debuts With Leading Performance
items.summaryZh: NVIDIA 博客报道了人工智能基础设施的发展。消息来源的要点：在今天发布的 MLPerf 基准测试中，NVIDIA Vera Rubin 平台在训练、训练后和代理推理方面提供了领先的性能。
items.summaryEn: NVIDIA Blog reports an infrastructure development in AI. Key point from the source: In its MLPerf benchmarks debut, with results released today, the NVIDIA Vera Rubin platform delivers leading performance across training, post-training and agentic inference.
items.overviewZh: NVIDIA 博客发布了有关“Vera Rubin 以领先性能首次亮相，NVIDIA 横扫 MLPerf 训练和端点”的最新更新。
items.overviewEn: NVIDIA Blog published a new update about “NVIDIA Sweeps MLPerf Training and Endpoints as Vera Rubin Debuts With Leading Performance”.

items.titleZh: Proton 的 Lumo 是 ChatGPT 和 Claude 的注重隐私的替代品，现已登陆桌面
items.titleEn: Proton’s Lumo, a privacy-focused alternative to ChatGPT and Claude, arrives on desktop
items.summaryZh: TechCrunch AI 报告了人工智能的行业发展。来源要点：Proton 适用于 Windows、Mac 和 Linux 的全新 Lumo 桌面应用程序可让用户跨文件和连接的应用程序自动执行任务，并对其 AI 可以访问的内容进行精细控制。
items.summaryEn: TechCrunch AI reports an industry development in AI. Key point from the source: Proton's new Lumo Desktop app for Windows, Mac, and Linux lets users automate tasks across files and connected apps, with granular controls over what its AI can access.
